conditions.name: Match rate definitions before using a trend
conditions.applies_when: Comparing years, geographies, roles or fee statistics.
conditions.check: Keep actual year/evidence period, currency, role/discipline, mean/median/minimum and supplier scope explicit. A dated comparison needs matching units.
conditions.model_implication: Retain dated reference values; select execution-date terms or labelled later scenarios. No automatic 2027 inflation or role-to-discipline decline.

conditions.name: Specify the delivery and billing unit
conditions.applies_when: Considering a supplier package, separate roles, marketplace sourcing or internal/hybrid delivery.
conditions.check: Define scope, capability, booked hours/days/minimum, inclusions, currency, fee/tax and payment terms, and retained JGA work. Map each actual hour once.
conditions.model_implication: Choose a package, task costs or reconciled split. Normalisation is a comparison, not purchasing terms. Worldwide USD range does not establish an Indian discount or GBP budget.

conditions.name: Allow for work beyond usable contributions
conditions.applies_when: Recruitment, participant handling, repeat review or capacity differs from the selected scenario.
conditions.check: Identify unsuccessful contact/cancellation/extra clarification or rework not already inside an allowance. Separate work hours from waiting time, staff availability and calendar sequencing.
conditions.model_implication: Reforecast only actual/explicit additional work without a fabricated success rate or duplicate handling. Preserve distinct-person and up-to-four Table event counting.

conditions.name: Identify the reusable asset and remaining work
conditions.applies_when: A prior report, framework, podcast, guide, public expert content or existing relationship is proposed to lower effort.
conditions.check: Record exact asset/version, task/country/evidence-date fit, applicable rights and the remaining validation, collection, handoff, editing and publication work.
conditions.model_implication: A genuine saved task can be credited once. Public content does not become new permissioned practitioner input, current evidence or free full production.

conditions.name: Verify assisted work before crediting savings
conditions.applies_when: Software or AI assistance is proposed for transcription, extraction, coding, writing or production.
conditions.check: Define permitted task/data/tool and capable delivery route, keep input/currentness/interpretation/output review, and observe the actual change in work before claiming a saving.
conditions.model_implication: Planned external AI projects and earlier generated answers do not prove JGA productivity or supplier capability. No percentage saving or tool activation adopted.
